quiet.description: true when no signal passed the checks: signals is then empty

date.description: the event's date, or the date a posting was first seen

claim.description: what happened, with names, counts and places. A role count says its source and the day it was counted

function.description: the role cluster for new roles, such as sales or machine learning

role_count.description: roles counted, never an estimate of headcount

inference.description: what the pattern suggests, worded as inference with the evidence it rests on; null when there is none

so_what.description: what it means for the owner, framed by the reason they watch the company

source_url.description: the posting, announcement, filing or notice itself, never a careers index or a search page

quiet_companies.description: every tracked company with no signal this run

report_markdown.description: the digest a person reads: a headline signal first, then one short section per company with a signal, then one line naming the quiet companies
